scope: First storage-growth fixes: bounded native notification refresh and lossless snapshot-content sharing

frequency.periodic: Existing global and individual periods preserved; current baseline is 600 seconds
frequency.notifications: Only native device/network-related source allowlists; full inventory deadline unchanged
frequency.storm_control: One pending source set per job; minimum 30 seconds after completion, exponential failure backoff capped at 1800 seconds
frequency.powershell: No PowerShell path for notification refresh

storage.representation: Each observation retains its envelope/timestamp/receipt/evidence; identical item arrays of at least 1024 bytes share immutable content
storage.identity: SHA-256 with byte comparison on reuse; content reference indexed by source/scope/run, independent of SQLite rowid/VACUUM
storage.atomicity: Content, snapshot, ref count and evidence are in the same ingest transaction
storage.retention: Remove shared content only when its final snapshot is removed under existing retention policy
storage.upgrade: Additive schema only, no rewrite/delete of retained production history, older binaries refuse schema 11

regressions: 20000 notification requests coalesce without postponing full inventory
User source disables respected; unknown future native sources excluded
1000 equal observations reconstruct their exact original envelopes
VACUUM does not break content references
Failed transaction and conflicting replay roll back
Missing/corrupt content raises an error rather than an empty inventory
Shared content preserves each observation time and historical state changes
Legacy payloads unchanged on migration; old writer refused

gaps.reason: Native source unavailable; previous state retained []: Driver store read requires an elevated Windows token

limitations: Benchmarks are isolated unchanged-service fixtures, not a forecast of whole-machine daily size
Existing large database is not compacted or rewritten
Evidence/projection queue rows still retain one observation each; their later compaction is a separate phase
Live observation covered startup and three notification refreshes, not a full ten-minute periodic cycle; timer boundaries also covered by unit tests.

CNG provider errors, selected registry access failures, virtualization compatibility failures and absent Sysmon/Hyper-V channels remain outside this storage/frequency change; listed in live validation.

deployment.enhanced_backend: Updated using one authorized UAC; version 0.2.42, elevated, same account and native-v2 instance

remaining: Compact completed projection metadata while preserving historical freshness and evidence addresses
Plan bounded historical deduplication/space reclamation separately; no full VACUUM on low-space live database
